findings: RG-001 HIGH PACKAGE_INTEGRITY — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:3-15 identifies PRS-REQ-001 version 0.2 and Draft status but omits its digest, repository revision, author, update time, and explicit included-source manifest. Read-only verification established the reviewed bytes, so this is a remediable specification defect rather than a review blocker. Affected: entire package. Required action: bind the package metadata to the verified artifact and source set. Owner: requirements specification author. Disposition: prevents PASS.

RG-002 HIGH MISSING_SECTION — The package lacks explicit mandatory sections for Purpose, Business context, Constraints, Dependencies, Validation strategy, Audit considerations, Failure and recovery, and Operational monitoring. Related statements scattered across sections 2-15 do not satisfy the mandatory-section rule. Affected: entire package. Required action: add each section or explicitly mark it not applicable with objective justification. Owner: requirements specification author. Disposition: prevents architecture readiness.

RG-003 HIGH MISSING_TRACEABILITY — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:284-297 maps broad requirement ranges rather than each source through business rule, requirement, acceptance criterion, and planned validation. Only 41 of 75 requirement identifiers appear explicitly in acceptance-criterion labels; requirements such as VR-003, VR-006, VR-008, OR-001, OR-002, OR-005, OR-006, and OR-007 lack precise criterion-level mapping. Required action: provide per-requirement traceability and classify missing or partial links. Owner: requirements specification author. Disposition: prevents PASS.

RG-004 HIGH NON_ATOMIC_REQUIREMENT — FR-007, FR-010, FR-018, and FR-019 combine independently verifiable obligations. AC-018 combines operations, lifecycle transitions, terminal-state rules, and outbox exposure across five resource categories, so independent obligations cannot receive precise pass/fail evidence. Required action: split independently decidable obligations and their acceptance criteria while preserving indivisible invariants. Owner: requirements specification author. Disposition: prevents PASS.

RG-005 HIGH MISSING_FAILURE_RULE — Sections 5, 8-15, and 16 do not comprehensively define timeout, malformed dependency response, crash/restart, retry classification and limits, poison-event handling, unknown publication outcome, key-capability failure, recovery ownership, and operator visibility. RabbitMQ publication and key-dependent identifier operations remain materially incomplete. Required action: specify observable failure and recovery behavior without inventing unapproved business policy. Owner: requirements specification author; escalate only if remediation exposes a genuinely new material choice. Disposition: prevents safe architecture work.

RG-006 HIGH MISSING_RISK — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:299-306 lists risks but omits required cause, consequence, likelihood, impact, affected assets or requirements, mitigation owner, acceptance authority, residual risk, and review trigger. Required action: complete the risk records while preserving the exact human decisions already recorded by factoryctl. Owner: requirements specification author. Disposition: prevents PASS.
